statements.text: `GET /tasks?status=<state>` returns only tasks whose status equals `<state>`, for each `TaskState` name (`Open`, `InProgress`, `Done`).
The status match is case-insensitive: `?status=open` returns exactly what `?status=Open` returns.
An unrecognised status value (e.g. `?status=Bogus`) returns HTTP 400 Bad Request and no task list.
`GET /tasks` with no `status` parameter returns all tasks — unchanged behaviour.
`dotnet build` and `dotnet test` stay green: the 5 pre-existing tests still pass (R-003).
The other CRUD endpoints (`GET /tasks/{id}`, `POST`, `PUT`, `DELETE`) keep their behaviour, and filtering lives at the endpoint/query boundary — `Domain/**` is not modified (R-004, R-005).
